title: FIFO Queues, Ordering & Exactly-Once Processing
summary: When order and deduplication matter: SQS FIFO, SNS FIFO, message groups and idempotency.
tldr: **SQS FIFO** keeps strict order *within a message group* and drops duplicates sent within the deduplication interval. Standard queues are at-least-once and best-effort order.
Set the **message group ID** to the entity that needs ordering (account, trader, instrument). Different groups are processed in parallel; one group for everything kills throughput.
Need ordered **fan-out** to several services? Publish to an **SNS FIFO** topic and subscribe one SQS FIFO queue per service.

keyFacts.text: The FIFO **deduplication interval**. A message with the same deduplication ID (or same body, with content-based deduplication) is accepted but not delivered again.
Default FIFO throughput per API action without batching; batching 10 messages per call gives up to 3,000 messages per second.
**High throughput mode** scopes deduplication and throughput to the message group, raising limits far above 300/s. Spread load across many group IDs.
FIFO queue and topic names must end in `.fifo`. You can't convert an existing standard queue to FIFO; create a new queue.
With a standard queue, make consumers **idempotent**: record each request ID with a DynamoDB conditional write and skip ones already processed.

comparisons.title: Compare: getting order and no duplicates
rows: Order doesn't matter and consumers are idempotent
Small volume that truly needs global order
SQS FIFO, group ID per entity
Thousands of messages/s across many groups
Several services each need every event in order

keywords.cue: process in order per account, in parallel across accounts
keywords.answer: SQS FIFO with message group ID = account ID

keywords.cue: never process twice even if the producer retries
keywords.answer: FIFO deduplication ID or content-based deduplication

keywords.cue: FIFO producers throttled at high volume
three services each need every event, in order, no duplicates
keywords.answer: SNS FIFO topic with an SQS FIFO queue per service

keywords.cue: duplicate charges from a standard queue, can't change queue type
keywords.answer: Idempotent consumer with DynamoDB conditional write

keywords.cue: strict ordering of trades per trader
keywords.answer: SQS FIFO with MessageGroupId per trader

traps: A single message group ID for all messages forces one-at-a-time processing and caps throughput.
Content-based deduplication exists only on **FIFO** queues, not standard queues.
A longer visibility timeout reduces redelivery but does **not** guarantee exactly-once processing.
An SNS **standard** topic in front of SQS FIFO queues loses the ordering guarantee; the topic must be FIFO too.
Several services polling **one** queue compete for messages; each message goes to only one of them.
Reserved concurrency of 1 slows everything down and still doesn't remove duplicates.
